title: 18 injured as fireworks display goes awry in Misamis Occidental
summary: ILIGAN CITY — A fireworks display marking the grand opening of the Christmas Festival of Lights 2026 in Tangub City, Misamis Occidental, turned dangerous on Saturday night when fireworks went awry…

blocks.text: ILIGAN CITY — A fireworks display marking the grand opening of the Christmas Festival of Lights 2026 in Tangub City, Misamis Occidental, turned dangerous on Saturday night when fireworks went awry and exploded toward spectators, injuring 18 people. Jhen Marie Rio, 24, of Lala, Lanao del Norte, was among those watching the display with her fiancé, Concord Paul Ramas Jr., 27, and four of their staff members. A few minutes after the fireworks began, an explosion occurred near where they were standing, about 150 meters from the display, Rio said.
